facts.fact: Ranu's grain sacks carry the regent's brass-bell store mark, the same as the redbark sack.
Meera carries Dilan's brass warden badge (taken from Kiran) in her coat, pressed under her left hand; Rohan has not been told.
Meera hides the seal out of Rohan's sight while he faces the wall and counts aloud to about 160; the hiding place is deliberately not shown (house, shed or woodpile within the rope's eight spans).
